d:
Matdata suchi men vishesh gahan punrikshan prakriya ke tahat huee kathit garabriyon par charcha aur logon ko matdata suchi men nam jurvane men madad ke lie dilli ke trilokpuri ilaqe men jansunvaee huee.
Jan sarokar, mazdur kisan shakti sangthan, votar adhikar manch, neshnal fedreshan of indiyan vumen ki or se aayojit is jansunvaee men lokasbha men neta pratipaksh rahul gandhi shamil hue.
Is dauran kaee matdataon ne dava kiya ki unhen matdata suchi se galat tariqe se hata diya gaya hai. bibisi sanvaddata dilanvaz pasha ki graund riport.
Shut aur edit mohammad mehroz
